changes: serve --no-worker skips built-in workflow workers and schedulers without changing API authorization or cancelling jobs.
Default serve/open and explicit worker execution retain their existing behavior.
Extension tasks and explicit graph operations remain enabled.

environment.static_parsers: crate-local Cargo configuration, prepared source bundle

method.heads: Eleven unique synthetic source snapshots per repository; unused owned Go constant changes value. Head zero warms the process, ten measured heads remain unseen. These are not real Git commits or independent PRs.
method.controls: One fresh CLI process per measured head; each control starts from a clone of the same post-warm state. The server accumulates caches naturally.
method.ordering: Nexus CLI controls before service calls; platform-rbac service calls before CLI controls.
method.timing: Admission, cloning and warmup excluded; no concurrent builds or tests. HTTP includes response decoding. CLI includes launch and output write, parses JSON after timing.
method.equality: Complete packets for each same-pin pair excluding only analysis_cache and tokens.
method.jobs: Original jobs retained; compare IDs, kinds, states, attempts and leases before/after every server batch. No connectors admitted and no graph-projection phases allowed.
method.memory: Graphicle process RSS sampled at phase boundaries. Concurrent phases are aggregated per batch, not attributed per request. Go child process memory and idle RSS are not measured.
method.dependency_provenance: Vendor and module files unchanged. Stale dependency_preparation metadata omitted for synthetic pins; no fresh dependency collection or verification claimed.

validation.lifecycle_test: passed: source admission, review, invalid credentials, preserved queued jobs, separate-worker processing, default serve resumes subsequent projection/link work
validation.stress: 20 head pairs / 40 reviews; all packet/cache/budget/job checks passed

limitations: Bounded ten-head sequence on each of two older local repository archives, not the eight production PR probes.
Small unused-constant edits in owned Go files; no dependency/profile changes or large refactors.
No steady-state or leak conclusion beyond this finite run. No idle RSS or total process-tree memory measurement.
Only concurrency one and two tested; unrelated host activity uncontrolled; observed throughput compares different synthetic heads, not a paired same-head throughput trial.
Natural service cache evolution can differ from fresh CLI controls; this is not a pure helper-cache ablation.
Admission and collection not included in review timings. Queue retention/growth needs an operational worker/retention policy; no job cancellation was used.

decision.reason: Concurrent output remains correct, but latency and retained server RSS rise. Memory did not return to its earlier sequential level in the two recovery requests.
decision.pending: Live eight-PR probe, longer memory/idle testing and deployment integration with explicit worker lifecycle.
